phase1_info_collection.summary: Material inventory complete: 3 kernel logs, 6 Lecroy .usb traces, 3 HTML reports. Two failure modes identified: Rev2Src#3 (FIXED) and Rev3ChkdSrc BU.1#1 (PERSISTENT). SRC.13 CTS spec file generated.

phase2_test_case_analysis.summary: Failure location mapped: Rev2Src SRC.13#3 FAIL Aug 21 only (FIXED Aug 24), Rev3ChkdSrc BU.1#1 FAIL all 3 dates. Error codes 0x00000381 (Error Recovery not detected within 15ms) and 0x000003A9 (VBus not present).

phase3_trace_analysis.summary: Root cause for SRC.13#3: SC27XX PD controller PHY-level TX failure (int sts=0x40) when sending PS_RDY after PR_Swap Rd transition. Internal HW retries exhaust after ~6ms, driver cleanup takes ~13ms before err_recover_state_en, total ~16ms exceeds tCtsErrorRecovery=15ms by ~1ms. Rev3ChkdSrc BU.1#1 not in Aug 21 log; PD 3.0 mode VBus init likely fails due to PD 2.0-only VIF.

phase4_log_analysis.summary: Kernel-level timing analysis across all 3 logs using internal sprd_pd_log timestamps. CRITICAL FINDING: PS_RDY TX error (int sts=0x40) occurs in ALL three logs (FAIL and PASS alike). Internal ERROR_RECOVERY→PORT_RESET transition is IDENTICAL (~2.6-2.8ms) across all three logs — fix is at SC27XX PD controller firmware level, NOT kernel driver. Previous claim of '18ms vs 3ms vs 1ms' was based on unreliable kernel capture timestamps — corrected. Rev3ChkdSrc BU.1 evidence: Aug 27 PD 3.0 Sink attach with HARD_RESET_SEND loop. All 8 Phase 3 open questions answered.

phase5_history_reference.summary: Historical bug reference analysis completed. Bugzilla REST API unavailable (enterprise network restriction). Cross-referenced 2 same-platform cases (3523357 SRC3.01, 3523391 SNK.12) and 1 related case (2743733 UMS9230). Primary failure pattern: Mode 3 (TCPCI/PD Controller IC anomaly) with PHY-layer TX error subtype. Key insight: Bug 3523357's enable_tx_auto_retry fix is partially applicable — same SC27XX hardware behavior root cause. Recommended P0: update SC27XX firmware. Identified Rev3ChkdSrc VBus issue as independent sub-problem.

summary.root_cause: SC27XX PD Controller PHY layer BMC transmit circuit recovery delay after PR_Swap Rd transition causes PS_RDY TX failure (int sts=0x40). Total time (HW CRC retry ~3ms + driver cleanup ~2.6ms + firmware PHY init ~10ms) exceeds tCtsErrorRecovery=15ms limit by ~1ms on Aug 21 firmware. Fix verified in Aug 24/27 firmware — not in kernel driver layer.
